headline: 2026 licensing round: How to bid for FG’s 40 oil, gas blocks
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has opened the 2026 licensing round for 40 oil and gas blocks. Companies must meet the steps, fees and documents requirements before the January 15 deadline.
why: Licensing rounds allocate exploration acreage to oil companies, influencing future output and investment in Nigeria's petroleum sector. Nigeria is one of Africa's largest oil producers.
